claims.claim: Recorded actions condition pixel-space diffusion; reward/termination are separate; actor-critic learns in imagination with real interaction used for collection.
Atari 100k: 26 games, 100k environment actions per game, 5 seeds; approximately 2.9 days per run on RTX 4090.
claims.qualification: 100k denotes environment actions in the paper; do not equate to raw frames or compute budget.

claims.claim: Mean HNS 1.459, IQM 0.641, 11 games above human baseline.
claims.qualification: Historical paper result within stated benchmark and comparator scope; not a current global SOTA claim.

claims.claim: Three denoising steps and illustrated multi-modal single-step failure.
claims.evidence_location: Official project How does it work; paper Section 5.2 and Figure 4

claims.claim: Static CS:GO training; 87 hours; two-stage generation; no RL; approximately 10 FPS demonstration.
claims.evidence_location: Official project Scaling to CS:GO; paper Section 6

claims.claim: Section 6 added after NeurIPS acceptance; quantitative measurement of CS:GO capabilities left to future work.
claims.qualification: Appendix M does contain separate earlier visual comparisons; do not state that the entire paper lacks all quantitative CS:GO visual metrics.

claims.claim: Limited memory and insufficient repeated-jump coverage produce invalid successive jumps.
Official repository exposes pre-trained interaction, training configuration and per-game/per-seed result file.
claims.evidence_location: README Try our playable diffusion world models; Configuration; Results
claims.qualification: No code execution or independent reproduction performed.

claims.claim: LAM infers latent actions using history and observed next frame during training; inference instead receives player-selected codes.
claims.qualification: Temporal causal attention mask does not establish causal identification.

claims.claim: Video tokenizer followed by token dynamics with MaskGIT; tokenizer first, then LAM/dynamics; VQ action codebook size 8.
Curated Platformers data approximately 30,000 hours; 160x90 at 10 FPS; training sequences 16 frames; model approximately 11B.
claims.evidence_location: Section 3 Datasets/Training Details; Section 3.1 Genie Model; Appendices B-D
claims.qualification: Paper describes total 10.7B rounded as 11B; curated source clips are 16 seconds, training sequences are 16 frames. Do not conflate these.

claims.claim: FVD evaluates generated video; delta PSNR evaluates effect of inferred vs random latent action, reported at t=4.
claims.qualification: Neither metric alone establishes true intervention effects or production safety.

claims.claim: CoinRun behavioral cloning: expert videos receive frozen-LAM labels; small ground-truth action set maps latent codes to real actions; Figure 14 reports 5 seeds and 200-example adaptation result.
claims.qualification: 200 samples concern adaptation mapping, not all model/agent training. Not general RL training inside generated Genie worlds.

claims.claim: Image/synthetic/sketch prompting and 2.5B action-free robotics video model appear in the official 2024 project.
claims.evidence_location: Enabling a new generation of creators; The future of generative virtual worlds
claims.qualification: Text examples may use Imagen2 to create an initial image; do not treat all core modules as text-conditioned.

claims.claim: Original model around 1 FPS with 16-frame memory; original paper reports unrealistic future hallucinations.
claims.qualification: Version-specific statement, not a claim about later Genie versions.

claims.claim: Original v1 did not accompany paper with model checkpoints/training data; Appendix F describes a smaller reproducible case study.
claims.evidence_location: Broader Impact Training Data and Weights; Reproducibility; Appendix F
claims.qualification: No independent main-model or case-study reproduction; does not assert no later release exists.

claims.claim: IT transfer needs operational semantics, aligned action/outcome trajectories and validation of constraints; visual quality and latent controllability do not establish intervention identification.
claims.evidence_location: Site-authored analysis based on the two papers' mechanisms and reported evidence scope

remaining_evidence_limits: No IT/cloud intervention, recovery, or production-safety experiments were found in the two scoped papers; site transfer discussion is analysis.
